spec.name: Blend v37
spec.notes: Combined signal, rebalanced on a slow schedule.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.2, annual return 12%, maximum drawdown 10%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy uses a full sample backtest without any out-of-sample validation, raising concerns about overfitting. The claimed performance metrics (Sharpe 2.2, 12% annual return, 10% max drawdown) are potentially inflated. While the costs are explicitly modeled, the lack of out-of-sample testing and the relatively high Sharpe ratio warrant paper trading before deploying real capital. The research log indicates this is not the best performing strategy of a set of five, further reducing confidence.
